title: REQ · Ignore and config paths point at game/ not backend/game
summary: Repository ignore rules and module config reference the new game/ location
description: Context: .gitignore line 10 is backend/game/node_modules/. vitest.config.ts includes tests/**/*.test.ts and tsconfig includes src and tests, both relative so valid after the move. Desired behavior: .gitignore ignores game/node_modules/ and no stale backend/game reference remains. Expected result: node_modules under game/ is never tracked. Why: avoid committing dependencies after relocation.
acceptance_criteria: Given .gitignore, when read, then it contains the line game/node_modules/
Given .gitignore, when read, then no line contains backend/game
Given game/vitest.config.ts and game/tsconfig.json, when read, then they include tests and src relative globs
